name: Portland, Oregon: residential building permit (process, submission, conventions)

review.note: Process, submission format and drawing conventions read on 2026-11-11 from the City of Portland pages cited, in our own words. Not confirmed by a Portland practitioner; the City decides what it requires. No building rules: Oregon's code is not in this pack. Sheet size, title block contents, maximum file size and fee amounts are not on the pages read and are left out.

source.name: City of Portland, Portland Permitting & Development

added: Added: approval steps, submission format, required drawings with scales, supporting documents and drawing conventions for a Portland residential permit, read 2026-11-11 (first version of this pack)

process.authority: City of Portland, Portland Permitting & Development
process.summary: Residential building permit: apply online through the City's portal, review with correction sheets, pre-issuance check, then the permit is emailed.

steps.title: Research the property, zoning and codes
Prepare the application, plans and supporting documents
Apply online and pass the intake check
steps.who: Applicant; a permit technician checks minimum standards
steps.handIn: The application, the drawings (one PDF) and the supporting documents (separate PDFs)
steps.detail: Applications of 35 pages and under may use the Single PDF Process; larger ones use another process the page does not describe. Paper plans may need an in-person appointment.

steps.title: Pay the intake fees
steps.handIn: Intake fees, so reviews can start

fee.text: Fees are based on the estimated cost of construction and materials; no amounts are on the page

steps.title: Review and corrections
steps.who: City reviewers; applicant answers every checksheet item
steps.handIn: Revised drawings uploaded for each checksheet, repeated until every review is approved
steps.detail: The page points to a timelines page updated weekly and states no number of days.

steps.title: Final check before issuance
steps.detail: The City checks approval stamps, notes and fees.

steps.title: Receive the permit and approved plans
steps.detail: The approved plans arrive as a link; the page says it is available for 60 days and that no printed set is provided. Permits expire 180 days after the Under Review date unless extended or reactivated.
steps.clause: Steps 6 and 7; Single PDF Process: Issuance

format.fileNaming: Under 50 characters, with no permit numbers, addresses or identifiers; calculation packets named Supplemental or Replacement.

copies.text: One set online; four sets if submitted in person. One set is stamped and returned for the job site.

format.stampSpace: Leave room for the City stamp in the top-right or bottom-right corner of each drawing.
format.note: Drawings in one PDF; application, calculations and other documents as separate PDFs. Disable font embedding; scans at 150 dpi; no digitally signed or permission-protected PDFs.

drawings.title: Site plan
drawings.detail: The entire lot at a scale of at least 1 inch = 10 feet, showing where the building sits relative to the property lines and other buildings.

scale.text: at least 1 in = 10 ft (1:120 or larger)

drawings.title: Floor plans
drawings.detail: One for each level where work occurs, existing and proposed, at 1/4 inch = 1 foot: all walls, room sizes and uses, a north arrow, windows with size and type, stairs and smoke detectors; bearing walls, headers and beams here or on framing plans.

drawings.title: Foundation plan
drawings.detail: For new buildings and additions: layout, dimensions and details of slabs, footings and reinforcing steel, concrete strength, crawl space access and foundation vents.

drawings.title: Section drawings
drawings.detail: Full sections usually at least 1/4 inch = 1 foot; wall sections and details at least 1/2 inch = 1 foot. Footings, foundation wall height, member sizes and spacing, coverings, insulation, ceiling heights; stair details for new or changed stairs.

scale.text: full sections at least 1/4 in = 1 ft (1:

drawings.title: Building elevation drawings
drawings.detail: For any exterior change, normally at 1/4 inch = 1 foot: ground level and slope at the building, windows and doors, siding and roofing, guardrails.

drawings.title: Framing plans and structural details
drawings.detail: Separate framing plans where load-bearing members are not on the floor plans; structural sections or details for more complex work.

documents.title: Building Permit Application (PDF form)
documents.detail: The completed application form; uploaded as its own PDF, not inside the drawing set.

documents.title: Structural calculations
documents.detail: For projects that change structural elements; uploaded as a separate PDF.
